elations","rel:xiangyun_weiruolan","status"]}]},"schema_version":1}},"previous_ending":{"selection":"LAST_THREE_PARAGRAPHS","text":"不多时饭来，宝玉只吃了半碗。宝钗见他停箸，也不劝，只把剩下的菜叫人收好。袭人进来问夜里还要不要汤，宝钗道：“他方才在老太太那里吃过酥酪，不必再添。你们也早些吃饭。”袭人答应一声，临出去又回头看看屋里，见宝玉低头翻书，宝钗收拢桌边散着的纸，便悄悄把帘子放下。\n\n宝钗收纸时，有一张被风吹到地下，便弯腰拾起压到书下，又把下午补过袖口的旧袍交给麝月挂好。麝月接了，随口道：“明儿二爷若又找不见，可别问我。”宝玉头也不抬地说自己已经记得，宝钗听见，只笑了一笑，没有再接。外间袭人正催一个小丫头把洗脸水倒去。那丫头嫌天黑不肯独自走，麝月提灯陪她，走到廊下还在笑她白日胆大、夜里怕鬼；袭人在后头叫她们轻些，别惊着上房。声音一层层远去，屋里只剩宝玉翻书的窸窣声和宝钗收针线的轻响。两个人各做各的，一时都没有说话。\n\n\n"},"scenes":[{"contract":{"authority_effect":"NONE","chapter":88,"chapter_plan_ref":"data/planning/chapters/ch88.json","entry_from":null,"entry_state":null,"event_refs":[],"evidence_effect":"NONE","exit_state":null,"function":null,"id":"88-S1","kind":"SCENE_SKELETON","knowledge_event_refs":[],"object_transition_refs":[],"order":1,"order_basis":"SOURCE_LIST_ORDER_NOT_VERIFIED_CHRONOLOGY","participants":null,"required_objects":null,"source_record":{"path":"data/prewrite/v06.json","pointer":"/omitted_scene_plans/7/candidate_scenes/0","ref":"data/prewrite/v06.json#/omitted_scene_plans/7/candidate_scenes/0","sha256":"caaa49d2f61760be27df0c9cbbc00433b6d54999199e08caec8260c8b15287ff","text_sha256":"72b815e4507c014ad09e1ee146a010aaec45a195c8ad52e65087d62a2fa50680","value":{"id":"88-S1","title":"婚事不能只从怡红院内部决定"}},"status":"DRAFT_IMPORTED","title":"婚事不能只从怡红院内部决定","unresolved":["entry_from","function","participants","required_objects","entry_state","exit_state","event_bindings","object_bindings","knowledge_bindings"]},"entry":null,"path":"data/planning/scenes/88-S1.json","unresolved":"DRAFT_SCENE_NO_EXECUTABLE_STATE_CONTRACT"},{"contract":{"authority_effect":"NONE","chapter":88,"chapter_plan_ref":"data/planning/chapters/ch88.json","entry_from":null,"entry_state":null,"event_refs":[],"evidence_effect":"NONE","exit_state":null,"function":null,"id":"88-S2","kind":"SCENE_SKELETON","knowledge_event_refs":[],"object_transition_refs":[],"order":2,"order_basis":"SOURCE_LIST_ORDER_NOT_VERIFIED_CHRONOLOGY","
